section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study. It describes obtaining ethical approval, opportunistically recruiting participants from various campus sites, obtaining informed consent, and administering a five-page paper-and-pencil questionnaire. Participants completed the questionnaire anonymously and individually, on a voluntary basis without remuneration, and were verbally debriefed upon return.
